retainedReference.title: Peter Harrison Planetarium, Royal Observatory Greenwich

pictures.author: Ethan Doyle White
pictures.observed: Actually viewed1280px exterior: broad patinated dark bronze oblique cone, pale reflective inclined elliptical cap, dark perimeter lip, restrained panel lines. South Building remains separate behind. No copied pixels/signs/cafe furniture.

pictures.author: Mike Peel (www.mikepeel.net)
pictures.observed: Actually viewed1280px north-facing shell/cap photo: cone tapers from broad circular base to an inclined reflective top disc; low front rim and high rear rim, thin dark edge, horizontal panels and central joint. Footing meets paving; no direct door in exposed cone. Temporary barriers omitted.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Independent exposed Peter Harrison Planetarium: mapped circular footing, oblique truncated bronze cone, sloping reflective metal cap with dark continuous rim and restrained panel seams. North rim is lower than south; X east/Z south. Preserve the independent South Building, Altazimuth Pavilion and every other campus building. Exterior above-ground cone only: underground theater, entry passages, interiors, furniture, barriers, signs and cafe are outside the mapped shell and omitted.
